summary: Tested HeartLink Admin Panel + notification flow end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: 19/19 tests pass for every endpoint listed in the request (health, dashboard-stats, fcm-status, pending-verifications, all-users w/ pagination+search, notifications GET/read, send-notification, notification-history, schedule CRUD, discover). Frontend: Admin Panel DOES load and work (admin login -> /admin -> Overview stats, All Users, Verifications, Notifications tabs all render with live data). E2E verified: user likes a profile from Discover -> POST /api/action returns 200 -> notification IS stored in db.notifications for the target ('Referral Tester liked your profile!', unread_count=1). ROOT CAUSE of 'custom/admin notifications not received/displayed' identified: (a) there is NO in-app notification UI anywhere in the frontend - GET /api/notifications/{user_id} has zero consumers, (b) POST /api/admin/send-notification never writes to db.notifications so admin messages exist only as FCM push, (c) NotificationManager silently swallows the success:false response so the admin gets no feedback at all. Added 6 extra tests that intentionally fail to document these + security/filter defects. Also added missing data-testid attributes to AdminDashboard.jsx and NotificationManager.jsx.

critical.issue: Does not persist a per-user record in db.notifications. Admin/custom notifications are FCM-push-only, so any user without an FCM token (all 10 users in preview) or who dismisses the push can never see the message in-app. This is the primary cause of 'custom notifications not received'.

No authentication/authorization on ANY admin endpoint. Verified with plain anonymous curl: /api/admin/all-users returns full PII (emails, phones, locations) and /api/admin/user/{id} DELETE, /api/admin/send-notification, /api/admin/clear-all-data are publicly callable. Server-side admin check missing (only frontend route guard on user.is_admin).

minor.issue: Ignores the gender/status/sort query params that AdminDashboard.jsx sends -> the Gender, Status and Sort dropdowns in All Users tab are non-functional (gender=female still returns males; status=banned returns all 10 users).

When 0 FCM tokens exist it returns early WITHOUT writing to notification_logs, so the admin Notification History stays permanently empty ('No notifications sent yet') even after send attempts. Failed/zero-token attempts should be logged.

No background worker consumes db.scheduled_notifications. A past-due scheduled notification stays 'pending' forever and is never sent. Only daily_notification_scheduler() exists and it does not read this collection. Schedule tab is a dead feature.
Broad try/except returns HTTP 200 with an empty list on any DB error, masking failures from the client. Should return 5xx or a structured error.
No user existence check and no auth - any caller can read any user_id's notifications (IDOR).

ui_bugs.issue: Silent failure: only handles res.data.success === true. When backend returns {success:false, message:'No users with FCM tokens found...'} nothing happens - no toast, no error, fields not cleared. Reproduced in browser: clicked Send Notification, 0 toasts appeared, title stayed 'TEST_QA Title'. Admin concludes 'notifications are broken'. Must show toast.error(res.data.message).

There is NO in-app notification screen: no /notifications route, no bell icon in TopBar/Navbar, and no component calls GET /api/notifications/{user_id}. Stored like/match/superlike notifications are therefore never displayed to the user. Navigating to /notifications renders a blank white page (no catch-all route either).
Gender / Status / Sort dropdowns change state and refetch but backend ignores the params, so the list never changes. Non-functional controls.
ui_bugs.selector: select (All Genders / All Status / Newest First)

ui_bugs.issue: Refresh button always calls fetchUsers() even on Overview/Notifications tabs, causing a wasted /admin/all-users request; it never refreshes pending verifications.

integration_issues.flow: Admin sends custom notification -> user receives
integration_issues.issue: Chain is broken at two points: (1) no in-app storage of admin notifications, (2) no in-app notification list UI. In preview FCM tokens = 0 so nothing is delivered and admin gets no error. Notification History also stays empty because the zero-token path skips notification_logs.

WORKING. Verified via UI click on [data-testid="like-btn"]: POST /api/action -> 200, and GET /api/notifications/{target} returns type='like', title='❤️ Someone liked you!', read=false, unread_count=1. Only the display side is missing.

issues: Uses raw browser-native <input type="date"> and <input type="time"> pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar component (2 native inputs detected)
No validation that the chosen schedule time is in the future
Action buttons (view/block/delete) are icon-only with no tooltip or aria-label - destructive delete is easy to hit by mistake
Gender badge falls back to pink styling for 'Unknown'/other genders
The 'Like'/'Pass'/'Super' text labels under the circular buttons are not clickable (only the icon circle is), so tapping the label does nothing - increase the tap target

Repeated console error on every page: 'Error initializing push notifications: CapacitorException: PushNotifications plugin is not implemented on web'. Should be guarded with Capacitor.isNativePlatform() to keep the web console clean

action_items: CRITICAL: Build an in-app notification UI (bell icon in TopBar/Navbar with unread badge + /notifications route/panel) that calls GET /api/notifications/{user_id} and POST /api/notifications/{user_id}/read. Without this, stored notifications are invisible - this is the real cause of issue #1.

CRITICAL: In POST /api/admin/send-notification, insert a db.notifications document for every targeted user (type='admin'/'custom') BEFORE/independently of the FCM send, so the message is visible in-app regardless of FCM token availability.
HIGH: Fix NotificationManager.handleSendNow to show toast.error(res.data.message) when res.data.success === false (currently a completely silent no-op).
HIGH: Add server-side admin authentication/authorization to every /api/admin/* endpoint (currently fully public, leaking PII and exposing destructive delete/clear-all-data).
MEDIUM: Implement gender/status/sort filtering in GET /api/admin/all-users (params are already sent by the UI) or remove the dropdowns.
MEDIUM: Always write to notification_logs (including failure/zero-token attempts) so Notification History reflects reality.
MEDIUM: Add a background dispatcher for db.scheduled_notifications, or hide the Schedule tab - scheduled notifications are never sent today.
LOW: Guard Capacitor PushNotifications init with Capacitor.isNativePlatform(); make Refresh tab-aware; add aria-labels to admin icon buttons; replace native date/time inputs with shadcn Calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 4029 lines - split into routers (admin, notifications, discover, auth, referral). Same for AdminDashboard.jsx (803 lines).
Admin endpoints have zero auth dependency; introduce a FastAPI dependency (e.g. require_admin) and apply it to the whole admin router.
get_user_notifications / mark_notifications_read swallow all exceptions and return 200 - callers cannot distinguish 'no notifications' from 'DB down'.
send_bulk_notification duplicates the FCM-token query logic used by fcm-status; extract a shared helper. Also it does not deduplicate tokens.
Notification creation logic in /action/{user_id} is duplicated 4 times (like/superlike/match x2) - extract a create_notification() helper.
/action/{user_id} inserts a new match document on every call with no duplicate/idempotency check, so repeated likes create duplicate rows and duplicate notifications.
AdminDashboard state has an unused `error`/ErrorFallback path that is never populated (setError is never called), so API failures only surface as toasts.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19) on the requested endpoints; 76% (19/25) including the 6 defect-documenting tests
success_rate.frontend: Admin Panel 100% loads/navigates/renders; notification delivery-to-user flow 0% (no UI to display notifications, silent send failure)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_notifications.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_admin_notifications.py -p no:randomly -v). Classes TestHealth/TestAuth/TestAdminPanel/TestUserNotifications/TestLikeCreatesNotification/TestAdminSendNotification/TestDiscover must stay 100% green. TestKnownDefects contains 6 tests that currently FAIL by design - they should turn green once the developer fixes admin auth, all-users gender/status filters, admin-notification persistence, notification_logs on zero-token sends, and the scheduled-notification dispatcher. data-testids now available: admin-dashboard-title, admin-refresh-btn, admin-tab-{overview,users,verifications,notifications}, admin-stat-<label-slug>, admin-user-card, admin-user-name, notif-tab-{send,schedule,history}, notif-title-input, notif-body-input, notif-target-select, notif-send-btn, notif-schedule-btn. Preview env has 0 FCM tokens so real push delivery cannot be tested here; verify push only on production (11 tokens). Admin Panel loads fine - the reported 'Admin Panel not working' could NOT be reproduced in the preview environment.
rca_of_the_issue: Issue 1 (custom/admin notifications not received/displayed): three independent gaps. (a) POST /api/admin/send-notification only calls FCM and never inserts into db.notifications, so admin messages have no in-app representation. (b) There is no frontend consumer of GET /api/notifications/{user_id} at all - no /notifications route, no bell icon, no component - so even the like/match notifications that ARE now stored correctly are never rendered. (c) NotificationManager.handleSendNow only branches on res.data.success === true; with 0 FCM tokens the backend returns success:false and the UI shows nothing, so the admin sees a silent no-op and also an empty History (the zero-token path returns before writing notification_logs). Issue 2 (Admin Panel not working): NOT reproducible on the preview URL - admin@heartlink.com logs in, /admin renders, 24 stat cards populate from /api/admin/dashboard-stats, All Users renders 10 user cards from /api/admin/all-users, Verifications and Notifications tabs load. If the user hit this in production it is most likely the heartlink.co.in -> www.heartlink.co.in redirect dropping the API calls (their .env must use the www host), or user.is_admin being false in their cached localStorage session which makes the /admin route guard redirect to /.
